references.text: Clear theological contrast: Judgment on the house of Eli (none will grow old) versus God's promise that Israel shall never again be childless.
Central theological contrast: Judgment on the house of Eli (extinction) versus God's promise to David (an eternal house and throne).
Direct narrative connection: Judgment on the house of Eli (1 Sam 2:32) prepares for the promise of David's eternal house (1 Kings 9:5).
